# Jayamadu Gammune — Robotics & Autonomous Systems Engineer

> Biomedical Engineering graduate (Robotics & Automation) at the University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka. Researcher in autonomous robotic systems, computer vision, GPU-accelerated medical imaging, learning-based control, and embedded systems. Open to PhD and research positions from Fall 2027.

## About

Jayamadu Gammune is a Biomedical Engineering graduate from the University of Moratuwa (Robotics & Automation pathway) with research experience at Swinburne University's Intelligent Robotics Laboratory (Melbourne, Australia) under Assoc. Prof. Mats Isaksson. His work spans GPU-accelerated robotic ultrasound imaging, vision-language models for robotic manipulation, EEG-based brain-computer interfaces, and autonomous embedded systems.

## Research Interests

- Robotics & learning-based control for manipulation
- Soft robotics and novel robotic mechanisms
- Mechatronic system design — UAVs & unmanned vehicles
- Computer vision & deep learning for perception
- Vision-language models for task understanding
- GPU-accelerated medical imaging

## Key Projects

- **RoboBrain 2.0**: Augmented CVPR 2025 baseline with LLM layer; 50% memory reduction via 8-bit quantization
- **GPU-Accelerated Robotic Ultrasound**: CUDA pipeline achieving 40% latency reduction in lumbar spine landmark detection
- **Pediatric EEG-Based BCI**: 5-DOF robotic arm controlled via real-time EEG and custom low-noise PCBs
- **Autonomous Micromouse**: STM32-based FloodFill maze-solving robot with FOC motor control
- **SLRC 2024 Robot**: National robotics competition autonomous mobile robot

## Education

- B.Sc. Engineering (Honours), Biomedical Engineering — Robotics & Automation, University of Moratuwa, Sri Lanka
